stories.summary: Assam Chief Minister Himanta Biswa Sarma on Friday (November 6, 2026) said the threat by a group led by an MLA to besiege his house over the Zubeen Garg death case posed a danger to his family. He told journalists in Guwahati that he would

stories.summary: Kashmir chief cleric Mirwaiz Umar Farooq on Friday (November 6, 2026) said the authorities disallowed him from leading the congregation prayers at Jama Masjid, apparently in response to the sermon delivered on the previous Friday on the Kashmir issue. “My house detention continues unabated for

stories.summary: Senior Communist Party of India (Marxist) (CPI[M]) leader Biman Basu on Friday (November 6, 2026) retracted his remarks, holding the veteran party leader and former West Bengal Chief Minister Jyoti Basu responsible for any issues with the industrial policy of the State during the regime

stories.summary: Former Chief Election Commissioner S.Y. Quraishi alleged that the West Bengal elections were not legally valid. He reinstated that the decisions at the Election Commission of India should be based on a majority. “Were the West Bengal elections legally valid? In my opinion, it was

stories.title: Supreme Court decision on BBMB arrears a victory for Himachal, says CM Sukhu
stories.summary: Himachal Pradesh Chief Minister Sukhvinder Singh Sukhu on Friday (November 6, 2026) termed the Supreme Court’s decision directing Punjab and Haryana to supply 11,973 million units of electricity to the State over 20 years towards its outstanding dues from the Bhakra-Nangal and Beas hydroelectric projects

stories.title: Karnataka CM ridicules BJP leaders for trying to take credit for PM’s visit
stories.summary: Chief Minister D.K. Shivakumar on Friday alleged that some BJP leaders were trying to take credit for Prime Minister Narendra Modi’s visit to Bengaluru on November 13 to inaugurate the metro Pink Line, even though he was arriving on the official invitation of the State

stories.title: Governor asks for status report on all public universities in Karnataka
stories.summary: Sudha Yadav, Governor of Karnataka and Chancellor of universities in the State, directed all public universities in the State to conduct a comprehensive review of their current operations and identify areas requiring improvement. The Governor instructed all Vice-Chancellors to prepare and submit a detailed report

stories.title: Delhi’s Mustafabad election official lodges police complaint seeking FIR over false Form 7s filing
stories.summary: The Electoral Registration Officer (ERO) of Mustafabad constituency has lodged a police complaint on Friday (November 7, 2026) seeking FIR under Section 31 of RP Act against the BLA following The Hindu’s report that false Form 7s have been filed seeking deletions of voters who

stories.title: Six arrested for threatening Telangana MLC with deepfake videos, demanding ₹5 crore
stories.summary: Six persons were arrested by Narsingi police for allegedly attempting to extort money from Telangana Legislative Council member Mirza Rahmath Baig by threatening to circulate his morphed photographs and deepfake videos on social media. The accused initially demanded ₹5 crore and subsequently collected ₹4.7 lakh,

stories.summary: Mamata All India Trinamool Congress leader and Diamond Harbour MP Abhishek Banerjee on Saturday (November 7, 2026) said that his residence was attacked by “BJP hooligans”. Mr. Banerjee shared the video of the attack on his social media handle and said that this was the

stories.title: Two sisters injured in shooting at Navi Mumbai home, one arrested, another on the run
stories.summary: Two sisters, 22 and 20, were injured after a man allegedly opened fire on them inside their home in Koparkhairane, Navi Mumbai, on Thursday night (November 5, 2026). Police have arrested a 22-year-old suspect in connection with the attack, while another accused remains absconding. The

stories.title: American national found dead in Gachibowli hotel room
stories.summary: An American national, Mitchell Brian Lee, 41, was found dead in his hotel room at Marriott Executive Apartments in Gachibowli on Thursday (November 6, 2026) evening. Lee, a resident of California, arrived in Hyderabad on November 2 along with his business partner, David Wu, for

stories.title: A missing persons complaint that unravelled Bengaluru’s seven murders
stories.summary: It was not until the mother of Nalini, one of the seven allegedly killed by cab driver-turned-YouTuber Indushekhar, lodged a missing person complaint that the police found the first clue to the murders. While the murders allegedly took place between October 16 and October 31,

stories.title: Investigation continues into Bengaluru murder site
stories.summary: Police are examining a small 500-square-foot terrace house in Rajajinagar where seven murders allegedly took place. The space, which served as a residence and a base for the accused's online activities, was reportedly filled with household appliances and items at the time of the investigation.

stories.title: Three hospitalised after fire at Mumbai high-rise
stories.summary: Three people were hospitalised following a fire at a 25-storey residential building in Ghatkopar East on Friday. The Mumbai Fire Brigade evacuated the building as a precaution. Police suspect a short circuit caused the blaze. All three patients are reported to be in stable condition.

stories.title: CNG leak causes fire in Orchha, 12 injured
stories.summary: Twelve family members suffered burn injuries after a CNG cylinder leaked at a scrap shop in Orchha on Friday. The owner was attempting to dismantle the cylinder to extract metal when the gas ignited. Two individuals remain in critical condition at a hospital in Jhansi.

stories.title: Delivery worker injured in police outpost blast
stories.summary: A 20-year-old delivery worker was injured during an explosion at a police outpost in Ghaziabad on Friday. The blast occurred in an air conditioning unit, shattering windows and cracking walls. A sub-inspector was also present at the time. An investigation into the cause is underway.

stories.title: Boy recounts travel with accused cab driver
stories.summary: A Bengaluru cab driver allegedly killed his wife and six relatives over a domestic dispute. Police say the suspect disposed of bodies across Karnataka while his 11-year-old nephew, whose parents were among the victims, travelled with him under the impression they were on a holiday.

stories.title: Cab driver arrested for seven murders in Bengaluru
stories.summary: Police arrested a 52-year-old cab driver for the alleged murder of his wife and six family members. Investigators believe the killings occurred over 15 to 20 days following a dispute. The bodies were discovered in various locations across Karnataka after a missing-person complaint was filed.

stories.title: Police detail timeline of Bengaluru cab driver murders
stories.summary: A 45-year-old cab driver has been arrested for the murder of his wife and six in-laws. Police commissioner Seemanth Kumar Singh stated the killings took place over a period of 15 to 20 days. The suspect allegedly dumped the bodies in multiple locations following a domestic dispute.

stories.title: University of Madras to revive AI lab
stories.summary: The University of Madras will partner with Sutherland Global Services to establish an AI laboratory at its Department of Women Studies. The company is renewing an older agreement after previous digital equipment was destroyed during the pandemic. The lab previously offered courses on workplace readiness.

stories.title: Regulator proposes satellite network licence
stories.summary: The Telecom Regulatory Authority of India has recommended a new licence allowing satellite firms to build networks and rent them to telecom operators. If approved by the Department of Telecommunications, companies like Starlink could operate as infrastructure providers without selling services directly to the public.

stories.title: Two arrested in 400 crore cyber fraud case
stories.summary: The Enforcement Directorate arrested two individuals linked to a 400 crore cyber fraud network. The accused allegedly offered fake investment schemes and jobs before laundering money through mule accounts and cryptocurrency. The agency has identified 600 related cybercrime complaints across several Indian states.

stories.title: CBI files 904 crore fraud case against Future Retail
stories.summary: The CBI has registered a case against Future Retail and its promoters, Kishore and Rakesh Biyani, for alleged diversion of 904 crore in bank funds. The agency conducted searches across Mumbai premises linked to the directors. The case includes charges of criminal conspiracy and cheating.

stories.title: Videocon promoter declared bankrupt
stories.summary: The National Company Law Tribunal has declared Videocon Industries promoter Venugopal Dhoot bankrupt over dues totaling 12,668 crore. Dhoot must now file a statement of financial position with a bankruptcy trustee. The tribunal bench issued the order one day before Dhanteras.

stories.title: World Trade Center township planned for Chengalpattu
stories.summary: GTB Developers has secured a licence to build a World Trade Center in Chengalpattu. The 100 to 150 acre IT-integrated township is valued at 7,000 crore and will be developed over ten years. The project includes commercial space, hospitality, residences and an education zone.

stories.title: Bharti Airtel market cap surpasses Jio Platforms
stories.summary: Bharti Airtel shares rose 2.5 percent on November 6, bringing its market capitalisation to 13,14,998 crore. The company reclaimed the second spot among Indian telecom operators, moving ahead of Jio Platforms. The shift follows the company's report of a 31 percent year-on-year increase in consolidated profit.

stories.title: CBI investigates Future Retail for 904 crore fraud
stories.summary: The CBI has booked Future Retail and its promoters for allegedly siphoning 904 crore in bank funds. The complaint, filed by SBI, alleges that funds were diverted to associate entities rather than used for sanctioned purposes. Searches have been conducted at multiple premises in Mumbai.

stories.title: Angel One overtakes Zerodha in active investors
stories.summary: Angel One has moved into second place among India's discount brokers with 69.98 lakh active investors. Zerodha now holds the third position with 67.6 lakh. Groww remains the largest broker with 1.37 crore active investors. The ranking is based on at least one trade per month.

stories.title: Assam bans drones near falcon sites
stories.summary: The Assam government has banned drone operations near Amur falcon roosting sites. The order follows reports of visitors flying drones to capture social media content near the migratory birds. The ban applies to all recreational and commercial drone activity during the seasonal period.

stories.title: Supreme Court clarifies forest rights eligibility
stories.summary: The Supreme Court ruled that individuals residing outside forest boundaries or those with temporary residence are not eligible for protection under the Forest Rights Act. The decision specifically excludes certain cultivators in the Agasthyamalai biosphere from being classified as traditional forest dwellers.

stories.title: Telangana plans climate-resilient urban infrastructure
stories.summary: Telangana is implementing a 20,000 crore project pipeline to improve climate resilience in its cities. The plan includes installing bamboo bus shelters and upgrading urban road codes. The measures are part of the state's long-term vision to integrate climate concerns into municipal infrastructure.

stories.title: Tamil Nadu increases compensation for human-wildlife conflict
stories.summary: The Tamil Nadu government has increased compensation for human-wildlife conflict. Payments for major injuries resulting in 20% to 60% incapacitation rose from ₹59,100 to a maximum of ₹5 lakh. Minor injuries, previously ineligible for payment, are now covered up to ₹20,000. The wildlife has not commented.

stories.title: Goa CM seeks to reopen mining leases in Western Ghats
stories.summary: Goa Chief Minister Pramod Sawant is pushing to reopen 153 iron ore mining leases in ecologically sensitive areas of the Western Ghats. Sawant requested a solution from the union ministry to allow auctions, citing a need to balance mineral resource extraction with the protection of sensitive locations.

stories.title: Supreme Court appoints panel to review forest rights in Tamil Nadu
stories.summary: The Supreme Court has appointed former Chief Justice Bhushan Gavai to lead a committee scrutinising forest rights claims in Tamil Nadu. The court criticised the state government for its prolonged failure to identify and adjudicate the claims of forest dwellers within the ecologically sensitive Agasthyamalai landscape.

stories.title: CAQM orders prosecution of Gurugram official over dust
stories.summary: The Commission for Air Quality Management has directed the Municipal Corporation of Gurugram to prosecute an executive engineer for failing to implement dust mitigation measures. The move follows reports of unattended heaps of loose soil and construction dust along city roads. The dust remains.

stories.title: Delhi-NCR implements Grap 3 restrictions as air quality worsens
stories.summary: Authorities have implemented Stage 3 of the Graded Response Action Plan in Delhi-NCR as air quality nears the severe category. The restrictions include a ban on various construction and demolition activities across the region, including Noida, Ghaziabad, and Gurugram, to curb rising dust pollution and emissions.

stories.title: NGT rules police must register FIRs for mineral theft
stories.summary: The National Green Tribunal has ruled that police and mining authorities are legally bound to register FIRs for the theft of state-owned minerals. The tribunal clarified that paying a penalty for illegal mining does not exempt an offender from criminal prosecution under the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita.

stories.title: Delhi-NCR records severe air quality in multiple areas
stories.summary: Data from the HT Pollution Dashboard shows 31 monitoring stations in Delhi-NCR recorded severe air quality on Friday. The overall air quality index reached 391, nearing the 400 mark that triggers the most restrictive pollution measures. The air remains largely unchanged.

stories.title: Supreme Court identifies vehicular emissions as major pollution source
stories.summary: The Supreme Court observed that vehicular emissions are a primary contributor to air pollution in Delhi-NCR. The bench suggested short and long-term measures to address the issue, while the Chief Justice noted the weather conditions in the capital during the opening of the proceedings.

stories.title: Environmental group flags land conversion rule changes in Tamil Nadu
stories.summary: Poovulagin Nanbargal has raised concerns over amendments to Tamil Nadu land conversion rules. The group argues that removing the requirement for District Collectors to personally inspect agricultural land before approving non-agricultural use weakens scrutiny. The government says it is simplifying procedures.

stories.title: US Justice Department drops California ballot lawsuit
stories.summary: The U.S. Department of Justice has moved to dismiss its lawsuit seeking to set aside 20,000 ballots in California. The federal government had alleged the votes were cast by noncitizens, a claim California officials and the presiding judge previously disputed. The case was scheduled for a hearing.

stories.title: US sanctions Canadian firms over Iran transactions
stories.summary: The U.S. Treasury has sanctioned Canadian money services firms for allegedly facilitating transactions for Iran. The move blocks the firms from the dollar-based financial system and prohibits transactions with U.S. entities. Secretary of the Treasury Scott Bessent stated that Canada cannot be a safe haven.

stories.title: France faces weekend of protests
stories.summary: French unions and student groups are planning nationwide protests this Saturday against the rising cost of living. A separate rally by the Yellow Vests movement is also planned in Paris despite a government ban. The demonstrations occur months before the upcoming presidential election.

stories.title: Iran distributes iodine tablets amid strike fears
stories.summary: Iran has begun distributing iodine tablets to residents living near nuclear facilities. An Iranian Health Ministry official cited concerns over potential U.S. military strikes. The government reportedly distributes the medication within a 2 to 3 kilometre radius of nuclear sites during periods of heightened military conflict.

stories.title: Trump hosts Diwali celebration at Oval Office
stories.summary: President Donald Trump celebrated Diwali at the Oval Office on Friday. The gathering included Indian-American administration members, entrepreneurs, and CEOs. The event featured the President lighting a diya in the presence of guests including Secretary of State Marco Rubio and FBI Director Kash Patel.

stories.title: China confirms discussions on Xi-Trump-Putin meeting
stories.summary: Beijing has confirmed it is in communication regarding a potential meeting between Xi Jinping, Donald Trump, and Vladimir Putin. The gathering would take place on the sidelines of a regional summit in Shenzhen. Experts note that the three leaders are unlikely to discuss substantive matters.

stories.title: Rubio to attend G7 meeting in France
stories.summary: Secretary of State Marco Rubio will travel to France this weekend for a G7 foreign ministers meeting. The trip follows Republican losses in the midterm elections, with Rubio expected to face questions regarding the future of the Trump administration's foreign policy approach toward allies and foes.

stories.title: Trump discusses West Asia tensions with Qatar
stories.summary: President Donald Trump held a telephone call with the Emir of Qatar to discuss de-escalation efforts in West Asia. The conversation focused on international attempts to reduce tensions in the region. Meanwhile, airstrikes in Yemen reportedly killed at least 30 people on Friday.

stories.title: Secret Service arrests man near White House
stories.summary: The Secret Service has arrested a man near the White House after finding him in a stolen vehicle with multiple guns. The suspect claimed he heard voices telling him to kill President Donald Trump. The arrest occurred Thursday night following reports of suspicious behaviour.

stories.title: Paraguayan president ousted following bank collapse
stories.summary: Paraguayan President Santiago Pena was placed under house arrest following his impeachment by the Senate. Lawmakers removed Pena over the collapse of a government-linked bank that left nearly half the population without access to their savings. The country is now preparing for a transition of power.

stories.title: Iran reviews proposals on nuclear programme
stories.summary: Iran is reviewing proposals from Qatar regarding differences with the United States over its nuclear programme. While the development has raised hopes for indirect talks, Iranian officials stated they remain unwilling to negotiate with the Trump administration until specific core conditions are met by the United States.

stories.title: Stephen Miller named White House chief of staff
stories.summary: President Donald Trump has appointed Stephen Miller as his new White House chief of staff, replacing Susie Wiles. Miller, a long-time adviser and architect of the administration's immigration policies, will lead the president's agenda as he prepares to engage with a Democratic Congress next year.

stories.title: India set to join EU research program
stories.summary: India is set to join the 93.5 billion euro Horizon Europe research program. The initiative aims to foster international scientific collaboration and innovation. Access to the full details of the agreement remains restricted by the server hosting the announcement. The server has not provided further comment.

stories.title: Anthropic faces valuation pressure ahead of IPO
stories.summary: Anthropic is facing scrutiny over its expected $1.5 trillion valuation as market conditions shift. Some investors are suggesting a range of $1 trillion to $1.3 trillion to attract buyers. The company is now weighing whether to proceed with its November IPO or wait for a better market.

stories.title: Deepinder Goyal unveils AI wearable
stories.summary: Deepinder Goyal has announced Temple 01, an AI wearable expected to ship in 2027. The device uses motion sensors to convert voice vibrations into text, removing the need for a microphone. Goyal described the technology as the world's first roomdeaf voice AI companion for the wearer.

stories.title: El Nino drives record cyclone activity
stories.summary: El Nino has pushed accumulated cyclone energy in the eastern Pacific to its highest level since 1950. The 2026 season has already surpassed previous records for the region. Further details were thin in the open report.

stories.title: New York faces heavy rain and flood risk
stories.summary: The National Weather Service has forecast heavy rain for New York, with up to five inches possible in parts of Long Island and Connecticut. Officials noted that the flood threat remains low as the rainfall is expected to be gradual, though localized ponding may occur in poor drainage areas.

stories.title: Shigellosis cases reported in Kerala school
stories.summary: Two additional children from Meppayil Senior Basic School have been diagnosed with shigellosis. The students were admitted to the Government District Hospital with fever and diarrhoea. Health officials have been monitoring the situation as patients continue to seek treatment for symptoms at various local medical facilities.

stories.title: Climate scientist P.V. Joseph dies at 94
stories.summary: Noted climate scientist P.V. Joseph has passed away at age 94. A former director of the India Meteorological Department training school, Joseph was known for discovering the low-level monsoon jetstream and conducting extensive research on monsoon onset and ocean-atmosphere instability throughout his career.

stories.title: Court questions medical records of former police chief
stories.summary: The Kerala High Court has requested medical records for former DGP Tomin Thachankary, who is currently incarcerated. The court questioned the genuineness of his hospitalisation, noting that while he claimed to be too ill for jail, he simultaneously argued he was fit enough to work in the UAE.

stories.title: Supreme Court denies bail to doctor in cough syrup case
stories.summary: The Supreme Court has denied bail to paediatrician Praveen Soni, who was arrested for allegedly prescribing Coldrif cough syrup linked to 26 child deaths in Madhya Pradesh. The court observed that the case was too serious to warrant his release from custody at this stage.

stories.title: Maharashtra plans cochlear implant expansion
stories.summary: The Maharashtra government is planning to expand cochlear implant surgery facilities to municipal corporation hospitals across the state. The initiative aims to provide early detection and treatment for patients with hearing impairments, following the model currently used by the Thane Municipal Corporation.

stories.title: Supreme Court denies bail to doctor in cough syrup case
stories.summary: The Supreme Court has refused bail to paediatrician Praveen Soni, accused of prescribing cough syrup linked to 26 child deaths. A bench led by Chief Justice Surya Kant declined to entertain the plea, noting the gravity of the charges involving the deaths of children in Madhya Pradesh.

stories.title: Delhi air quality report access
stories.summary: Access to the details regarding the ex-AIIMS chief's comments on Delhi air quality is currently restricted. The full piece is for subscribers. Further details were thin in the open report.

stories.title: Grant awarded for autism grief study
stories.summary: The Child Development Centre in Thiruvananthapuram has received a 35-lakh rupee grant to develop a tool for assessing grief among parents of children with autism. The three-year project will include interviews with families and professionals to create a culturally relevant assessment method.

stories.title: SCTIMST faces criticism over surgery delays
stories.summary: Sree Chitra Tirunal Institute for Medical Sciences and Technology is facing criticism regarding long waiting periods and appointment cancellations. Hospital officials acknowledged the difficulties, stating that patient volume has increased to a level where the current facility is struggling to meet the demand for care.

stories.title: ISRO chairman meets Tamil Nadu chief minister
stories.summary: ISRO chairman V. Narayanan met with Tamil Nadu Chief Minister C. Joseph Vijay at the state secretariat on November 6. The meeting lasted over thirty minutes and included representatives from NABARD. The full details of the discussion are available to subscribers of the publication.

stories.title: Kozhikode science centre opens interactive gallery
stories.summary: The Regional Science Centre and Planetarium in Kozhikode has opened a 900 square foot gallery featuring 34 interactive exhibits. The facility aims to make complex scientific principles like electromagnetism and acoustics engaging for all ages. Visitors can now observe a ball suspended in mid-air by airflow.

stories.title: Study finds expansion in Keralam mangrove cover
stories.summary: A study by the ICAR-Central Marine Fisheries Research Institute found an overall increase in Keralam mangrove cover between 2017 and 2026. This growth occurred despite the state losing 90 percent of its mangroves over the past five decades. The vegetation serves as a nursery for fish.

stories.title: Jaipur shop sells gold coin-shaped sweet
stories.summary: A shop in Jaipur has introduced a sweet shaped like a gold coin for the Diwali season, priced at 1.23 lakh rupees. The product is intended to mark the festival. Access to the specific details regarding the ingredients or availability is currently restricted by the server.

stories.title: Suriya stars in Jithu Madhavan dark comedy
stories.summary: Director Jithu Madhavan has released the dark comedy Scene, starring Suriya. The film is described as an engaging experience that feels like watching a large firecracker burst with timed perfection. It marks a potential hat-trick of box office hits for the actor in 2026.

stories.title: Suriya film generates holiday box office anticipation
stories.summary: The film Scene, directed by Jithu Madhavan and starring Suriya, has become a major release for the Deepavali weekend in Tamil Nadu. The film is expected to continue the actor's streak of hits for 2026. The industry is currently measuring the scale of the public hype.

stories.title: Tamizh Padam 3 begins production
stories.summary: Production has commenced on the third installment of the Tamizh Padam spoof franchise. Lead actor Shiva returns as the protagonist, now billed as an intergalactic superstar. The film continues the series' tradition of parodying popular Tamil cinema tropes. Athulya Ravi will serve as the female lead.

stories.title: Disco film relies on costumes over plot
stories.summary: The mafia film Disco features gang members who frequently dress in elaborate costumes, including Santa Claus outfits and goat masks, before committing crimes. The film borrows heavily from established gangster tropes. The costume designer appears to have been the most active member of the production team.
